ai_review.summary: Unknown‑source recording of a late‑era show that shines on the tail end, especially Foolish Heart into New Speedway Boogie.
ai_review.review: Although the reviewer isn’t usually a fan of the later era, this May 1991 performance stands out, with the ending stretch from Foolish Heart through New Speedway Boogie receiving particular praise. Hornsby’s keyboard presence is noted for prompting the veteran members to bring their A‑game. No specific comments on recording fidelity were provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights strong musical moments but gives no information about the audio source, leading to a solid yet cautious rating.
